mapper.select: SELECT p.ID AS id, p.PRJ_NAME AS prjName, p.PRJ_DESC AS prjDesc, sc.NAME AS prjStatusCd, p.START_DATE AS startDate, p.CLOSED_DATE AS closedDate, p.CREATED_ON AS createdOn FROM PROJECT p INNER JOIN GRP g ON g.PRJ_ID = p.ID INNER JOIN MEMBER m ON m.GRP_ID = g.ID LEFT JOIN SUB_CODE sc ON sc.S_CODE = p.PRJ_STATUS_CD AND sc.M_CODE = '00PROSTAT' WHERE m.USER_ID = #{userId} and p.prj_status_cd not in('04PROSTAT', '05PROSTAT') GROUP BY p.ID, p.PRJ_NAME, p.PRJ_DESC, sc.NAME, p.START_DATE, p.CLOSED_DATE, p.CREATED_ON ORDER BY p.CREATED_ON DESC
